policy: Every await in maintained C#/Razor source is explicit. Ordinary awaits must end in ConfigureAwait(false/true); ConfigureAwait(false) is the mandatory default. ConfigureAwait(true) is limited to renderer/circuit-affine component continuations. await foreach must configure its async enumerable with ConfigureAwait(false). await using must configure asynchronous disposal explicitly; preconfigured awaitable variables are not an exception.
awaitUsingPolicy: Every await using construct must visibly configure the IAsyncDisposable with ConfigureAwait(false/true); raw language-level async disposal is forbidden.
preconfiguredAwaitablePolicy: Awaiting ConfiguredTaskAwaitable variables directly is forbidden; await the originating Task with explicit ConfigureAwait(false/true).
